datasets.name: DSPaymentTer
datasets.sql:
select  
ict.id,
ict.cid, 
/*ictd.trid,
ictd.trid1,
ictd.trid2,*/
ict.stage_tesdiq_dat,
nvl(pr.lammount,0) as mebleg,
sb_p.name
from
ins_contract_terminated ict,
ins_contract_terminated_detal ictd, 
sb_business_opers sb_o,
sb_business_processes sb_p,
provarch pr
where ict.cid=:Pcid
and ictd.ter_id=ict.id
and (ictd.trid=sb_o.parentid or ictd.trid1=sb_o.parentid or ictd.trid2=sb_o.parentid)
and  pr.id=sb_o.parentid
and  sb_o.busproc in(21,22,23,24,25,26,27)
and  sb_p.id=sb_o.busproc

datasets.name: DSTerBarderoSay
datasets.sql:
select count(*) as say from ins_terminated_bardero
where cid=:p_cid

datasets.name: DSPaymentTerReal
datasets.sql:
select
itp.cid,
itp.id,
itp.traid,
itp.paydate,
nvl(itp.ammount,0) as mebleg,
sb_p.name
from
ins_terminate_payment itp,
sb_business_opers sb_o,
sb_business_processes sb_p,
provarch pr
where itp.cid=:PCID
and   pr.id=itp.traid
and   itp.traid=sb_o.parentid
and   sb_o.busproc in(56)
and   sb_p.id=sb_o.busproc

datasets.name: DSpaymentAcc
datasets.sql: select id, acc_no from account where id in(select acc_id from ins_dict_acc_payment_loss)

datasets.name: DSqaliq
datasets.sql:
select (select  
sum (nvl(pr.lammount,0))
from
ins_contract_terminated ict,
ins_contract_terminated_detal ictd, 
sb_business_opers sb_o,
sb_business_processes sb_p,
provarch pr
where ict.cid=:pcid
and ictd.ter_id=ict.id
and (ictd.trid=sb_o.parentid or ictd.trid1=sb_o.parentid or ictd.trid2=sb_o.parentid)
and  pr.id=sb_o.parentid
and  sb_o.busproc in(21,22,23,24,25,26,27)
and  sb_p.id=sb_o.busproc)-
(select

nvl(sum((itp.ammount)),0)

from
ins_terminate_payment itp,
sb_business_opers sb_o,
sb_business_processes sb_p
where itp.cid=:pcid
and   itp.traid=sb_o.parentid
and   sb_o.busproc in(56)
and   sb_p.id=sb_o.busproc) as qaliq
from dual
